reviews.game: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls Ultimate Edition
reviews.content:
Gostei muito do jogo, gráficos lindos, na mesma pegada do Marvel Rivals, 3D imitando 2D, notei que algumas pessoas avaliaram mal o desempenho do jogo, mas certamente o pc da pessoa é fraco ou esta mal configurado, eu rodei liso e me diverti muito, lembra muito a pegada dos jogos da Marvel Vs Capcon, deu ate uma nostalgia, além disso o jogo esta em português, se preocuparam em dublar os personagens com dubladores famosos dos personagens nos filmes.



Porem como nem tudo são flores, o modo campanha, acho muito exaustivo, pois tem muita conversa e pouca ação, quando parte pra luta, vc conclui muito rápido a partida e passa para uns 10 min só de papo da campanha ate ir para a próxima luta, tirando isso achei o jogo muito legal, divertido e interessante, mas não acho que o valor esteja correto pelo que o jogo esta entregado, afinal é a mesma empresa que fez o DragonBall Z Fighting, pelo que notei é a mesma pegada não é nada de tão inovador, tirando os gráficos que resgatam muito o estilo do Marvel Vs Capcom, porem é a mesma receita já existente no Dragon Ball Z Fighting, para min se a versão mais cara custasse em torno de 150 já estaria de bom tamanho, mas o jogo é bom sim, certamente vou comprar ele quando surgir uma promoção.

Beau visuellement, mais c'est tout ce que le jeu a pour lui. La physique est horrible,voitures qui glissent, le nombre d'armes différentes est ridiculement bas. Le personnage a une vessie de souris. Il pisse sans arrêt. La map est gigantesque et pourtant tellement vide. On comprend très vite pourquoi le jeu a bidé dès sa sortie. Dommage qu'il n'y ait pas de remboursement sur instant gaming.

reviews.game: Call of Duty: Black Ops II
reviews.content:
How Happy I Am About Black Ops 2 Coming to PS5



I honestly cannot explain how happy I am that Black Ops 2 is finally coming to PS5. This is probably one of the games I have been waiting for the most, and it means a lot more to me than just another Call of Duty game. Black Ops 2 has been my favorite game since I was a child, so seeing it come back on a modern console feels really special.



I remember playing Black Ops 2 when I was younger and spending hours playing it without even realizing how much time had passed. At the time, I did not really care about graphics or whether a game was considered old or new. I just wanted to play. Everything about the game was fun to me, from the campaign to multiplayer and especially Zombies. Even now, when I think about the games I played as a kid, Black Ops 2 is probably the first one that comes to my mind.



The Zombies mode is probably the biggest reason why I love the game so much. Maps like Mob of the Dead, Origins and Buried are still some of my favorite Zombies maps ever made. I remember playing them with friends, trying to survive as many rounds as possible and figuring out the Easter Eggs. Sometimes we had no idea what we were doing and would just run around trying different things until something worked. Even when we failed, it was still fun because we were playing together.



Origins is probably the map that I have the strongest memories of. It was difficult, but that was part of what made it so good. Getting the staffs, upgrading them, doing the Easter Egg and trying to survive the higher rounds always felt like an achievement. Even today, I can go back to Black Ops 2 and still enjoy it, which says a lot about how good the game was.



Multiplayer was also a huge part of my childhood. The weapons, maps, killstreaks and overall gameplay just felt perfect to me. I especially loved how different the game felt compared to newer Call of Duty games. It was fast, but it also required skill, and getting a good game felt really satisfying. There was something about coming home, turning on the console and immediately starting a few matches that I will always remember.



That is why having Black Ops 2 on PS5 makes me so excited. Being able to play one of my favorite childhood games again on the console I use today feels almost like getting a part of my childhood back. I know that technically it is an old game, but for me it does not feel old. The memories are still there, and I think that is what makes certain games special.



I am also really looking forward to playing it with friends again. A big part of what made Black Ops 2 so enjoyable was playing with other people, especially Zombies. Being able to do Easter Eggs, mess around in multiplayer and just have fun together on PS5 is something I have genuinely missed.



Overall, I am extremely happy that Black Ops 2 is coming to PS5. It is not just because I want to play an old Call of Duty again. It is because this game has been a part of my life for so long. It reminds me of being a kid, playing for hours and not worrying about anything else. There are many new games that I enjoy, but Black Ops 2 will always have a special place for me. Being able to play it again on PS5 is honestly something I never thought I would be this excited about, and I cannot wait to start playing it again.
